conceptZh: 森是三棵木堆在一起，很多樹就成了森林
object: a caped action-figure hero with an overlong cape and three popping toy trees in boxes
morph: three surprise boxes pop open one after another, each releasing a tree-shaped 木 so that one sits on top of two others to form 森
creativeAngle: 披風英雄打開一個又一個驚喜盒，每個都彈出一棵樹，三棵木疊成「森」；披風蓋住他的頭是反覆的小笑點，詞用「森林」。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale warm-white backdrop, locked camera. The only text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 森, centered in saturated pine-green strokes about 70 percent of frame height, built from three wood radicals 木, one centered on top and two side by side below it. Cast: Captain Flop, a chunky caped toy action figure with a bright orange cape three sizes too long that keeps flopping over his own head, and three small red gift boxes with springy lids. Moment one, 0 to 1.7s: Captain Flop strides in with a heroic pose, tripping on the end of his cape, and points at the first red box. The first 森 is spoken as he lifts the lid and a springy sapling bursts out on a coil, becoming the top 木. Moment two, 1.7 to 3.4s: the cape drops over his face and he stumbles blindly into the second box, which pops open with a boing; a second tree shoots out to the lower left and he does a huge double-take, cape flipped up like a tent, mouth wide. The second 森 is spoken as the second tree bounces into place. Moment three, 3.4 to 5.0s: he tiptoes toward the third box, wraps his cape around it like a magician, and counts on his fingers one, two, three; the lid flies off and the last tree rockets up and lands to the lower right with a bounce and a shower of green leaves, locking the glyph together. Moment four, 5.0s onward: three tiny owl toys land on the branches and Captain Flop gives them a thumbs-up, his cape fluttering gently behind. From 5.0 to 8.0s the glyph is perfectly still and uncovered while Captain Flop stands at the bottom corner, turns into a small dance, and flaps his cape like a pair of wings, never touching the strokes. Audio: a warm friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「森、森、森林」, slowly with clear tones as ㄙㄣ、ㄙㄣ、ㄙㄣ ㄌㄧㄣˊ. First 森 near 0.7s, second near 2.4s, and 森林 around 5.3s as the owls land. Stop after the word. Only soft boings and rustles, no background music. Soft studio lighting, vivid not neon colors, no flashing, no lens flare, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no writing other than the single glyph 森.

conceptZh: 布忍者為了輕輕拍一下小種子而誇張地全力助跑，結果整個衝過頭、煙霧彈還提早爆開，他冒煙倒滑回來一屁股撞上花盆，被風吹起的三顆種子正好落成一高兩低的三角形，他再用一根手指輕輕一點，三棵毛氈小樹同時彈高，排成森字。
object: a low felt planter box of brown soil holding three tiny green felt seeds that each spring up into a felt tree shaped as 木
morph: the ninja's overshoot gust tosses the three seeds into a triangle in the soil (one high center, two low side by side); his gentle fingertip tap makes all three sprout into pine-green felt trees, each an upright trunk with a straight horizontal branch bar and two splayed roots, stacking into 森
creativeAngle: 改用「用力過頭」的物理笑點：布忍者把「輕拍一顆種子」當成忍者大任務，瘋狂助跑衝過頭、煙霧彈提早爆、冒煙倒滑撞花盆，撞擊本身把種子甩成正確的三角位置，再用輕輕一點完成發芽，笑點與字形生成是同一個動作。與上一版披風英雄開禮物盒的概念完全不同，也不用機器人；消防小隊因這個笑點不需要第二角色而省略，畫面只保留忍者、花盆和三棵樹，乾淨好讀。「森林」唸出時，三棵樹飄落葉、小松鼠探頭，忍者在角落被落葉蓋成一叢小樹叢「成功隱身」，呼應他愛躲又躲不好的個性。
promptEn:
An 8-second stop-motion-style felt animation on a clean solid pale cream backdrop, locked camera, soft even lighting. The only text ever on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 森, centered and about 70 percent of frame height with clear margins, built from three felt trees that are each a correct 木: an upright trunk, one straight horizontal branch bar crossing it high, and two slanting roots splayed at the bottom; one tree centered on top, two side by side below it. Lead: Scrappy, a tiny black felt ninja with visible stitched seams, round button eyes and a long red felt headband, convinced he is invisible, with a lumpy felt smoke bomb tied to his belt that always goes off at the wrong moment. Prop: a low felt planter box of brown soil at center with three tiny green felt seeds poking out, waiting for one gentle pat.

Moment one, 0 to 1.5s: Scrappy "hides" behind a flowerpot far smaller than himself at frame left, both button eyes peeking over the rim. He spots the seeds, points two fingers at his eyes and then at the seeds, and winds up for the tiny pat with a ridiculous two-arm windmill, headband whipping in circles. The first 森 is spoken as the windmill hits full speed.

Moment two, 1.5 to 3.2s: He rockets across the frame, misses the planter completely, and his smoke bomb pops mid-sprint in a harmless lavender puff so he shoots out of frame right as a blur. The gust of his run lifts all three seeds spinning into the air. He skids back in reverse on smoking felt feet, BONKS bottom-first into the planter with a squashy thump, the planter wobbles, and the three seeds rain down and stick in the soil in a neat triangle: one high in the middle, two low side by side. He sits up with a dazed cross-eyed grin and a little swirl of stars.

Moment three, 3.2 to 4.8s: a frozen beat of anticipation: Scrappy tiptoes to the planter, extends one finger, and gives the top seed the gentlest tap. Boing: all three seeds shoot upward into tall pine-green felt trees, trunks straightening, branch bars clicking level, roots splaying, locking the glyph 森 crisp and centered. The second 森 is spoken as the trees snap into place near 4.3s.

Moment four, 4.8 to 8.0s: the glyph holds perfectly still, centered and uncovered. The word 森林 is spoken near 5.5s as a flurry of little felt leaves drifts down from the three trees and a tiny felt squirrel pops up on the planter rim to peek at the forest. Scrappy, in the bottom-left corner, yanks his last smoke bomb, which only fizzles late, while the falling leaves settle on his head so he stands proudly "camouflaged" as a small bush, giving a thumbs-up, never touching the strokes.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「森、森、森林」, read exactly as ㄙㄣ、ㄙㄣ、ㄙㄣ ㄌㄧㄣˊ, slowly with clear tones. First 森 near 1.0s, second near 4.3s, 森林 near 5.5s. Stop after the word, no other speech. Only soft poofs, boings and a felt thump, no music louder than the voice. Bright but not neon colors, no flashing, no lens flare, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no writing other than the single glyph 森.
